descriptionHtml:
Structured felt. Padded high sides. A den whose walls do not fold.

Thirlmere is a felt nest and den dog bed with structured walls and padded high sides, in Small 45 × 55cm, Medium 54 × 74cm and Large 66 × 74cm. The base is cushioned.

Most nest beds go shabby inside two years and everyone has quietly accepted it. On a soft-sided one it is the walls that fail first. Your dog leans, the side folds outward, and the bed you chose for its walls becomes a flat mat with a lump round the edge.

This one is built in structured felt, so the sides carry their own shape when a dog puts weight into them.

What they get

  • Structured felt walls: They stand up on their own instead of flopping outward under a leaning dog.
  • Padded high sides: Firm underneath and padded where a back or a shoulder presses against them.
  • A cushioned base: Soft underfoot inside a properly enclosed den shape.
  • Three sizes: 45 × 55cm, 54 × 74cm and 66 × 74cm on the outside.

Best for: Heavy leaners, dogs who want an enclosed den rather than an open mat, and anyone whose last nest bed went flat at the sides.

Why it is worth the money

Small is £79, Medium £99 and Large £139. A wall that stays up is the whole point of a nest bed, and it is the first thing to go on a soft-sided one. Structured felt is what you are buying here, with padding placed where they actually press. Over 100 nights you will see for yourself whether the sides are still doing their job.

The catch is wash day. This bed does not go in the machine, because a machine cycle is precisely what would wreck the felt structure holding those walls up. Follow the sewn-in care label and air-dry instead.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Small45 × 55
Medium54 × 74
Large66 × 74

These are outside measurements and the structured walls take a good part of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label and air-dry. Do not machine wash the felt structure.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Which size suits my dog?

Curled-up length plus 15 to 20cm, remembering the walls are thick.

What will delivery cost me?

Nothing once you are past £40. The shipping page carries timings.

Can I pay in instalments?

There is, and it is listed at the checkout stage.

What stops the sides collapsing?

The felt is structured, so each wall carries its own shape.

Will an older dog manage it?

Padded high sides are still sides to climb. Your vet should weigh that.

Can I actually wash it?

Not in a machine. Clean it to the label and air-dry.

What if he will not use it?

It comes back within the 100 nights, free of charge.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Pick their size and give them a den with walls that hold.
